metadata.title: Polymarket Appoints First Chief Financial Officer

content.text:
Polymarket has appointed its first chief financial officer (CFO) as the prediction market grows and matures.
The privately held company said that it has hired veteran executive Warren Jenson, who previously served as CFO at Amazon (NASDAQ: $AMZN), to be its first-ever chief financial officer.
Jenson will report to Polymarket founder and CEO Shayne Coplan, who called him a "legend" on social media.

Going forward, Jenson will oversee Polymarket's financial operations and capital strategy. He will also have responsibility for the company's long-term planning.
The CFO appointment comes as Polymarket grows in hopes of scaling its prediction market platform that lets people bet on the outcome of real-world events such as sports and elections.
The CFO appointment also comes a Polymarket prepares for an initial public offering (IPO) that could take place within a year or two, say some analysts.
Polymarket is pushing deeper into sports betting, especially during the NFL football season, putting it in direct competition with betting platforms such as DraftKings (NASDAQ: $DKNG).
Prior to Amazon, Jenson served as president and CFO at Nielsen, where his responsibilities included finance, strategy, technology, and corporate development.
The executive currently sits on the board of directors at cryptocurrency firm Ripple (CRYPTO: $XRP).
As a private company, Polymarket's stock does not trade on a public exchange.
